speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) syndrome.

The combination of a new rash on the upper back, sudden onset cough, and mucositis shortly after starting new arthritis medications is highly suggestive of this serious adverse drug reaction. Please proceed with a CBC with differential and liver function tests immediately to check for eosinophilia and hepatitis. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Liver_Function_Tests.
